description: Mara owns a handmade outdoor pizza oven and must decide whether to accept a caterer's proposal to use it in exchange for cash and catering for Mara's family anniversary gathering. A second neighbor has also expressed interest in buying the oven, and Mara makes the final call after hearing from both people.

agents.name: Mara
agents.role: Pizza Oven Owner and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: Mara's handmade outdoor pizza oven is in working condition and has been offered locally for $500.
shared_context.S2: Mara needs food for a family anniversary gathering on August 24 and has not arranged the meal yet.
shared_context.S3: Eli and Tess have each expressed interest in making an arrangement involving the oven.
shared_context.S4: Before finalizing a bargain, Mara routinely asks each interested person to state the exact terms they are prepared to honor, then compares those terms aloud.

PF1.text: Eli's exact proposal is fixed and non-negotiable: he will pay Mara exactly $150, use the oven to prepare and serve exactly 30 pizzas with ingredients supplied by Eli at Mara's August 24 gathering, pick up the oven on August 17, and return it on August 25.

PF2.text: Tess's exact offer is fixed and non-negotiable: she will pay exactly $475 in cash at pickup on August 18 for the oven, with no catering or other service included.

acceptance_conditions: Mara must accept Eli's proposal rather than sell the oven to Tess.
The accepted arrangement must include exactly $150 in cash from Eli.
Eli must provide exactly 30 pizzas at Mara's August 24 gathering.
The oven must be picked up on August 17 and returned on August 25.
The settlement must record Tess's exact $475 cash alternative.
A catering commitment for Mara's August 24 gathering must be logged.
Mara must cite Eli's exact proposal when justifying the final arrangement.
Mara must cite Tess's exact cash alternative when justifying the comparison between the arrangements.

content_checks.C3: 'PF1' in revealed and decisions['pizzas_provided'] == 30 and decisions['event_date'] == 'August 24'
content_checks.C4: 'PF1' in revealed and decisions['oven_pickup_date'] == 'August 17' and decisions['oven_return_date'] == 'August 25'
content_checks.C6: 'PF1' in revealed and ((any((c['type'] == 'catering' or c['type'] == 'catering_service' or c['type'] == 'catering_commitment') and '30' in c['detail'] and 'pizza' in c['detail'] and 'ingredient' in c['detail'] and 'August 24' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)) or any(c['type'] == 'agreement' and '30' in c['detail'] and 'pizza' in c['detail'] and 'ingredient' in c['detail'] and 'August 24' in c['detail'] for c in commitments))

decisive_facts.why: Eli's fixed exact proposal changes the selected party to Eli, sets the cash payment to exactly 150, sets the catering quantity and date to exactly 30 pizzas on August 24, fixes pickup and return as August 17 and August 25, and supplies the terms for the required catering commitment.

Tess's fixed exact offer changes the comparison entry from an unknown alternative to exactly 475 dollars in cash at pickup on August 18 and provides the fact ID required to substantiate that recorded alternative.
